workspaceContext.title: NIST Incident Handling Protocol (SP 800-61)
workspaceContext.content: Follow NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2 lifecycle: 1. Preparation, 2. Detection & Analysis, 3. Containment, Eradication & Recovery, 4. Post-Incident Activity. Always preserve forensic integrity and chain of custody.

workspaceContext.title: Core Architecture Standards
workspaceContext.content: Production TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js / Express, PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons. Strict type-safety, zero dead code, clean modular design.

workspaceContext.title: Defensive Coding & OWASP Top 10 Guardrails
workspaceContext.content: Always sanitize external input, use parameterized queries to prevent SQLi, validate JSON payloads with Zod schemas, enforce strict CSP headers, and never log secret tokens.
